# .NET Full-Stack Development Expert

## 1. Architecture & Design Patterns

### Core Principles
- **SOLID Principles**: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion
- **Design Patterns**: Repository, Factory, Singleton, Strategy, Observer, Dependency Injection
- **Clean Architecture**: Separation into UI, Business Logic, Data Access layers

### Recommended Project Structure
```
Solution/
├── src/
│   ├── ProjectName.Core/          # Domain entities, interfaces
│   ├── ProjectName.Infrastructure/ # Data access, external services
│   ├── ProjectName.Application/    # Business logic, services
│   └── ProjectName.UI/             # Web/WinForms/WPF presentation
└── tests/
    └── ProjectName.Tests/          # Unit and integration tests
```

## 2. C# Best Practices

### Type Safety & Performance
```csharp
// Option Strict equivalent - enforce strict typing
#pragma warning disable CS8602, CS8603 // Explicit null checks

// Async/Await for non-blocking operations
public async Task<List<CustomerDto>> GetCustomersAsync()
{
    return await _repository.FindAllAsync(c => c.IsActive);
}

// Nullable reference types
public string? GetCustomerName(int id) => _cache.Get(id)?.Name;

// Pattern matching for clean code
public string FormatPrice(object price) => price switch
{
    decimal d => $"${d:N2}",
    int i => $"${i:N0}",
    _ => "Invalid price"
};
```

### Entity Framework Core
```csharp
// Efficient queries with Include and AsNoTracking
public async Task<List<Order>> GetOrdersWithDetailsAsync(int customerId)
{
    return await _context.Orders
        .AsNoTracking()
        .Include(o => o.OrderItems)
            .ThenInclude(i => i.Product)
        .Where(o => o.CustomerId == customerId)
        .OrderByDescending(o => o.OrderDate)
        .ToListAsync();
}

// Bulk operations for performance
await _context.Products
    .Where(p => p.CategoryId == categoryId)
    .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s.SetProperty(p => p.IsActive, false));
```

## 4. ASP.NET Core Web API

### RESTful Controller Design
```csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class ProductsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IProductService _service;
    private readonly ILogger<ProductsController> _logger;

    public ProductsController(IProductService service, ILogger<ProductsController> logger)
    {
        _service = service;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<ActionResult<PagedResult<ProductDto>>> GetProducts(
        [FromQuery] int page = 1,
        [FromQuery] int pageSize = 20)
    {
        var result = await _service.GetPagedAsync(page, pageSize);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ProductDto>> GetProduct(int id)
    {
        var product = await _service.GetByIdAsync(id);
        return product is null ? NotFound() : Ok(product);
    }

    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ProductDto>> Create([FromBody] CreateProductRequest request)
    {
        var product = await _service.CreateAsync(request);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetProduct), new { id = product.Id }, product);
    }
}
```

### Middleware Pipeline
```csharp
// Global exception handling
app.UseExceptionHandler(errorApp =>
{
    errorApp.Run(async context =>
    {
        context.Response.StatusCode = 500;
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";

        var error = context.Features.Get<IExceptionHandlerFeature>()?.Error;
        _logger.LogError(error, "Unhandled exception");

        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new { error = "An error occurred" });
    });
});

// Authentication middleware
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
```

## 5. Windows Forms Modern UI

### Fluent Design Implementation
```csharp
public class ModernDashboard : Form
{
    private readonly Panel _headerPanel;
    private readonly CardPanel _contentArea;

    public ModernDashboard()
    {
        // Set modern styling
        BackColor = Color.FromArgb(32, 32, 32);
        Font = new Font("Segoe UI", 9F, FontStyle.Regular);

        InitializeComponents();
        ApplyMaterialDesign();
    }

    private void ApplyMaterialDesign()
    {
        // Flat design with subtle shadows
        _headerPanel.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(45, 45, 48);
        _headerPanel.Padding = new Padding(24, 16, 24, 16);

        // Hover effects for buttons
        foreach (Control ctrl in GetAllControls(this))
        {
            if (ctrl is Button btn)
            {
                btn.FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat;
                btn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
                btn.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(0, 120, 215);
                btn.Cursor = Cursors.Hand;
            }
        }
    }

    private IEnumerable<Control> GetAllControls(Control parent)
    {
        foreach (Control child in parent.Controls)
        {
            yield return child;
            foreach (var descendant in GetAllControls(child))
                yield return descendant;
        }
    }
}
```

## 6. WPF Modern UI

### MVVM Pattern
```csharp
// ViewModel
public class MainViewModel : ViewModelBase
{
    private readonly ICustomerService _service;
    private ObservableCollection<CustomerViewModel> _customers;
    private CustomerViewModel _selectedCustomer;
    private bool _isLoading;

    public ObservableCollection<CustomerViewModel> Customers
    {
        get => _customers;
        set => SetProperty(ref _customers, value);
    }

    public CustomerViewModel SelectedCustomer
    {
        get => _selectedCustomer;
        set => SetProperty(ref _selectedCustomer, value);
    }

    public bool IsLoading
    {
        get => _isLoading;
        set => SetProperty(ref _isLoading, value);
    }

    public ICommand LoadCommand { get; }
    public ICommand SaveCommand { get; }

    public MainViewModel(ICustomerService service)
    {
        _service = service;
        LoadCommand = new AsyncRelayCommand(LoadAsync);
        SaveCommand = new AsyncRelayCommand(SaveAsync, CanSave);
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        IsLoading = true;
        try
        {
            var customers = await _service.GetAllAsync();
            Customers = new ObservableCollection<CustomerViewModel>(
                customers.Select(c => new CustomerViewModel(c)));
        }
        finally
        {
            IsLoading = false;
        }
    }
}
```

## 7. Performance Optimization

### Async/Await Best Practices
```csharp
// DO: Use Async for I/O-bound operations
public async Task<string> ReadConfigAsync()
{
    return await File.ReadAllTextAsync("config.json");
}

// DON'T: Use Async for CPU-bound operations
public async Task<int> CalculateFactorialAsync(int n)
{
    // Wrong - blocks thread pool
    return await Task.Run(() => CalculateFactorial(n));

    // Better - if truly needed
    return await Task.Run(() => Enumerable.Range(1, n).Aggregate(1, (a, b) => a * b));
}

// Parallel execution
public async Task<List<Report>> GenerateReportsAsync(List<int> departmentIds)
{
    var tasks = departmentIds.Select(id => GenerateReportAsync(id));
    var results = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
    return results.ToList();
}
```

### Memory Management
```csharp
// IDisposable pattern
public class DataReader : IDisposable
{
    private StreamReader? _reader;
    private bool _disposed;

    public string ReadLine()
    {
        EnsureNotDisposed();
        return _reader!.ReadLine() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private void EnsureNotDisposed()
    {
        if (_disposed) throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(DataReader));
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        Dispose(true);
        GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
    }

    protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
    {
        if (!_disposed)
        {
            if (disposing) _reader?.Dispose();
            _disposed = true;
        }
    }
}

// Using statements
public async Task ProcessFileAsync(string path)
{
    await using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
    await using var reader = new StreamReader(stream);
    var content = await reader.ReadToEndAsync();
    // Automatic disposal
}
```

### Caching Strategies
```csharp
// Memory cache with expiration
public class ProductCache
{
    private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
    private static readonly TimeSpan DefaultExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30);

    public async Task<Product?> GetProductAsync(int id)
    {
        var key = $"product_{id}";

        if (_cache.TryGetValue(key, out Product? product))
            return product;

        product = await _repository.GetByIdAsync(id);

        if (product is not null)
        {
            _cache.Set(key, product, DefaultExpiration);
        }

        return product;
    }
}
```

## 8. Legacy Modernization

### Refactoring Checklist
1. **Remove implicit late binding** - Enable Option Strict, add explicit types
2. **Extract methods** - Break large methods into focused functions
3. **Introduce interfaces** - Enable dependency injection and testing
4. **Async conversion** - Replace synchronous I/O with async/await
5. **Modern UI** - Apply fluent/material design patterns

### Before/After Examples

**Before (Legacy VB.NET)**
```vbnet
Sub ProcessOrder(orderId As Integer)
    Dim conn As New ADODB.Connection
    Dim rs As New ADODB.Recordset
    conn.Open("connection string")
    rs.Open("SELECT * FROM Orders WHERE Id = " & orderId, conn)
    If Not rs.EOF Then
        Dim status As String = rs("Status")
        If status = "Pending" Then
            rs("Status") = "Processed"
            rs.Update()
        End If
    End If
End Sub
```

**After (Modern C#)**
```csharp
public async Task ProcessOrderAsync(int orderId)
{
    var order = await _context.Orders.FindAsync(orderId);

    if (order is null) return;

    if (order.Status == OrderStatus.Pending)
    {
        order.Status = OrderStatus.Processed;
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}
```

## 9. Testing & Quality

### Unit Testing with xUnit
```csharp
public class OrderServiceTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IOrderRepository> _mockRepo;
    private readonly Mock<IEmailService> _mockEmail;
    private readonly OrderService _service;

    public OrderServiceTests()
    {
        _mockRepo = new Mock<IOrderRepository>();
        _mockEmail = new Mock<IEmailService>();
        _service = new OrderService(_mockRepo.Object, _mockEmail.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ProcessOrder_WhenPending_ShouldUpdateAndSendEmail()
    {
        // Arrange
        var order = new Order { Id = 1, Status = OrderStatus.Pending };
        _mockRepo.Setup(r => r.GetByIdAsync(1)).ReturnsAsync(order);

        // Act
        await _service.ProcessOrderAsync(1);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(OrderStatus.Processed, order.Status);
        _mockEmail.Verify(e => e.SendOrderConfirmationAsync(1), Times.Once);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(OrderStatus.Pending, true)]
    [InlineData(OrderStatus.Shipped, false)]
    [InlineData(OrderStatus.Cancelled, false)]
    public async Task ProcessOrder_ShouldOnlyProcessPendingOrders(
        OrderStatus status, bool expectedUpdate)
    {
        var order = new Order { Id = 1, Status = status };
        _mockRepo.Setup(r => r.GetByIdAsync(1)).ReturnsAsync(order);

        await _service.ProcessOrderAsync(1);

        Assert.Equal(expectedUpdate ? OrderStatus.Processed : status, order.Status);
    }
}
```

## 10. Common Patterns Reference

| Pattern | Use Case | Implementation |
|---------|----------|----------------|
| Repository | Data access abstraction | `IRepository<T>.GetByIdAsync(id)` |
| Unit of Work | Transaction management | `IUnitOfWork.BeginTransactionAsync()` |
| Factory | Object creation | `IOrderFactory.Create(customerId)` |
| Decorator | Cross-cutting concerns | `ILogger<T>` wrapping service |
| Mediator | Request handling | `IMediator.Send<T>(query)` |
| CQRS | Read/write separation | Separate query/command handlers |

## 11. UI/UX Guidelines

### Design Principles
- **Consistency**: Use same patterns across application
- **Feedback**: Show loading states, success/error messages
- **Affordance**: Make actions obvious
- **Hierarchy**: Guide eye through importance

### Responsive Design
```csharp
// Adaptive layouts
public void AdjustLayout(Form form)
{
    var screenWidth = Screen.PrimaryScreen.Bounds.Width;

    if (screenWidth < 1024)
    {
        // Tablet/mobile layout
        tableLayoutPanel.ColumnStyles[0].Width = 0; // Hide sidebar
    }
    else
    {
        // Desktop layout
        tableLayoutPanel.ColumnStyles[0].Width = 250;
    }
}
```

### Accessibility
- Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for text
- Tab navigation order follows visual flow
- Tooltips for icon-only buttons
- Screen reader compatible labels

## 12. Security Best Practices

### Input Validation
```csharp
public class CustomerValidator : AbstractValidator<Customer>
{
    public CustomerValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(c => c.Email)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Email is required")
            .EmailAddress().WithMessage("Invalid email format");

        RuleFor(c => c.Age)
            .InclusiveBetween(18, 120)
            .WithMessage("Age must be between 18 and 120");

        RuleFor(c => c.Name)
            .NotEmpty()
            .MaximumLength(100)
            .Matches("^[a-zA-Z ]*$").WithMessage("Name can only contain letters");
    }
}
```

